locator: pp.11-13: pp.11–12, coherence and boundary replies; pp.12–13, concluding qualification and dialectical advantage
interpretation: Della Rocca argues for powerful and unrebutted reason to accept PSR given the accepted explicability arguments and absence of a principled rebuttal, while expressly conceding he has not shown there is no legitimate line. This is his positive dialectical warrant with its stated limit, not attribution of an unconditional deduction, a proof from bare speech, or an endorsement by this corpus of all his rejection-of-rebuttal moves.
